verdict_text: NO. The regex omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 96 of the 112 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16 and the 16 `o_proj` weights stay float32, violating Required result 1. The script also hardcodes the bfloat16 count check to 96 instead of 112, violating the Required checks clause "exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16", so the wrong dtype assignment passes silently instead of failing loudly.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
